speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome). The clinical picture of asymmetric oligoarthritis (ankle, now knee), sterile pyuria (WBCs in urine), and conjunctivitis following sexual activity is classic for this condition, often summarized as the "triad" of arthritis, urethritis, and conjunctivitis. The negative rheumatoid factor further supports this diagnosis.
